candidates.description: This vector represents fragments of common Thai words and prefixes, most notably the nominalizer "ความ" (khwam).
This vector represents the Thai consonant 'ม' (Mo Ma) combined with various vowels and preceding words.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai vowel and tone mark characters, along with occasional unrelated ASCII artifacts.
This vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "in" across various languages and writing systems.
This feature vector activates strongly on multilingual proper names and foreign subword tokens.
This feature vector represents Thai character sequences and subwords, particularly those containing the Thai consonant 'ป' (Po Pla) and vowel combinations, along with a few English words.
This vector activates on foreign-language characters, multilingual subwords, and diverse linguistic script fragments.
These tokens represent lowercase vowels and vowel combinations featuring various diacritics and phonetic variants across different languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter 'd' and its phonetic equivalents across multiple languages and scripts.
This vector represents characters, subwords, and abbreviations commonly found in Southeast Asian scripts, particularly Thai, mixed with Latin characters and linguistic prefixes.
